summary: Procaccianti Hotel REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report board-authorized distributions on its Class K and Class K-I common stock and Class K OP units. The distributions accrue at seven percent per annum ($0.001917808 per share/unit per day) for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Aggregate authorized amounts are $665,355 for K Shares, $248,516 for K-I Shares, and $22,115 for Class K OP Units. The filing is a routine distribution declaration, not a special situation—no acquisition, sale, tender, restructuring, or strategic event is disclosed.
